page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.large is an entry-tier general purpose virtual machine from the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz with dedicated CPU allocation. The configuration provides 1 physical core presenting 2 virtual cores (vCPUs) via hyperthreading, backed by 32 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache. The CPU incorporates modern instruction sets including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 extensions, AES, BMI2, and FMA. System memory totals 8.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance comes with no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage, and provides a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without complimentary public IPv4 addresses or discrete GPUs.

Benchmark results highlight an expected division between single-thread efficiency and aggregate multi-core capability. Single-threaded compute delivers mid-tier results within the middle 50% percentile, registering 1572.49 in stress-ng single-core tests, 1350.0 in Geekbench single-core, and consistent data compression rates of 27.19 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip and 10.47 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. However, because the instance operates on a single physical core with two threads, overall parallel capacity ranks in the bottom 10% tier. This constraint is evident in the PassMark CPU score of 2536.99, Geekbench multi-core score of 1615.0, and a clang compilation score of 2082.0. Memory throughput on large 256 MB uncached blocks reached 16.29 GB/sec read and 14.38 GB/sec write.

Given its minimal core count and absence of high-speed local disk volumes, ecs.g7ne.large represents a low-density general-purpose resource. Throughput-sensitive operational benchmarks remain low, with PassMark database operations at 820.1, Redis SET commands reaching 2.02 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput measured at 2.48 GB/sec. These characteristics make the instance best suited for lightweight, low-concurrency workloads such as staging servers, basic proxying, lightweight background jobs, and small containerized microservices that benefit from dedicated Intel vector capabilities without requiring intensive multi-threaded performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.large is a general purpose instance powered by a dedicated 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor with 1 physical core and 2 vCPUs. Equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory configuration. The server lacks bundled local storage and GPUs, relying on remote disks and offering 2 Gbps baseline networking. In benchmark assessments, it demonstrates mid-tier single-core execution with a 1350.0 Geekbench single-core score and solid single-threaded compression. However, overall multi-core and memory throughput reflect its limited two-thread scale, placing in the lower benchmark tiers for PassMark CPU, Redis operations, and software compilation. Without local high-speed storage, ecs.g7ne.large is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, low-traffic web services, minor background workers, and development or staging environments.
